instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion are imported and initialized smoothly in JS files.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or generic tech blue (#1B93A4) or purple (#7351B7). Stick rigidly to warm ivory (#F8F5F0), deep forest dark (#131C18), and antique gold (#C5A059).
All headings must use Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display. Do NOT use Inter for main headings.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive controls, form fields, tabs, navigation links, and primary section headers.
Form inputs must use customized Shadcn/UI or Tailwind components with focus states matching gold ring border (#C5A059).
Never use generic placeholder images or broken links. Use the provided Unsplash URLs in image_urls.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop aesthetic: refrain from basic centered layouts, repetitive cards, or generic gradients.
Ensure high contrast compliance (APCA / WCAG AA) for all text against light and dark backgrounds.
Maintain generous padding (p-8 to p-16) on all section containers to reflect high-end luxury.
Add interactive hover micro-animations on buttons and cards (e.g. scale 1.02, gold subtle glow, border transition).
All test attributes must follow kebab-case format, e.g., data-testid='enquiry-submit-btn'.
